name: soames-wordpress-plugin
description: Dev/test tooling for the Soames WordPress plugin. The plugin itself is PHP — nothing here ships to WordPress. This version field is a courtesy mirror: the version of record is the `Version:` header in soames-wordpress-plugin.php, which is what WordPress reads and what the release workflow checks the git tag against.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run env:start && npm run seed && playwright test
scripts.lint:php: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app php:8.2-cli sh -c 'find /app -name "*.php" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l'
